title: Street Fair
text: Your booth sells out before noon.

title: Parking Ticket
text: The meter ran out during the good part.

title: Family Reunion
text: Everyone chips in for the long table.

title: Group Gift
text: You cover the bill and smile anyway.

title: Surprise Twins
text: The spare room is no longer spare.

title: Headhunter
text: A college offer lands on your kitchen table.

title: Cash Advance
text: The bank calls it help. The interest disagrees.

title: Bake Sale
text: The neighborhood clears the last tray.

title: Roof Leak
text: Buckets were a temporary business plan.

title: Birthday Lap
text: Friends pass you an envelope each.

title: Wedding Toast
text: You buy the room another round.

title: New Niece
text: Someone hands you a very small person.

title: Bonus Gig
text: The weekend work actually pays.

title: Fender Bend
text: The other driver is already on the phone.

title: Charity Mile
text: You pledged more than you planned to run.

title: Found Wallet
text: You return it. The reward still counts.

title: Storm Windows
text: Every neighbor needs the same repair.

title: Moving Day
text: Pizza for the crew comes out of your pocket.

title: Art Prize
text: The local show writes you a check.

title: Career Leap
text: You take the offer with the longer title.
